Bivariate summer-trend map on the project circle (L'IF n° 49 method)

Source: R/climat_cercle.R
climat_tendance_bivariee.Rd

Crosses the total change over the period (least-squares slope × (last year − first year)) of summer maximum temperature (°C) and summer precipitation (mm) into a bivariate classification, at the native resolution of the series from climat_ete_series() (spec 063). A cell needs at least 80% valid years. Each axis is clipped to its bounds and cut into n classes.

Periods: "complete" (all the years of the series), "if49" (2006-2020, Figure 1 of L'IF n° 49) or c(debut, fin).

Bounds (bornes): "if49" (fixed, ΔT ∈ [−0.7, 4] °C, ΔP ∈ [−270, 120] mm, default for periode = "if49"); "france" (default otherwise: 1% and 99% quantiles, extended to 0, of the E-OBS changes over metropolitan France for the same years and months — the same colours for neighbouring projects and across sources; needs the machine E-OBS monthly cache, falls back to "emprise" with meta$bornes$reason otherwise); "emprise" (same quantiles on the circle, as in the source scripts); or an explicit list(tmax = c(lo, hi), precip = c(lo, hi)).

The class is (ct - 1) * n + cp, ct = 1 for the smallest Tmax rise to n for the largest, cp = 1 for the driest to n for the wettest; so "hot & dry" is (n - 1) * n + 1. meta$palette$colors[classe] gives the colour: the 10 × 10 palette read on the Figure 1 legend ("if49_10x10", needs n = 10), or the bilinear interpolation of four corner colours ("coins", any n).

Usage

climat_tendance_bivariee(
  series,
  periode = "complete",
  bornes = NULL,
  palette = c("if49_10x10", "coins"),
  n = 10L,
  cache_path = NULL,
  eobs_cache_dir = NULL,
  version = "33.0e"
)

Arguments

series

The result of climat_ete_series().

periode

"complete", "if49" or c(debut, fin).

bornes

NULL (default, see above), "france", "if49", "emprise" or a list of explicit bounds.

palette

"if49_10x10" (default) or "coins".

n

Classes per axis (default 10).

cache_path

Optional .tif path: the class raster is written there, the two change layers to <name>_tendances.tif and the meta to <name>.meta.json (the app reads them back across a future worker).

eobs_cache_dir

Machine-wide E-OBS cache, for bornes = "france".

version

E-OBS version of that cache (default "33.0e").

Value

list(raster, tendances, meta): raster is an integer SpatRaster classe_bivariee (1..n²) on the native grid and CRS of the source; tendances a 2-layer SpatRaster (tendance_tmax in °C, tendance_precip in mm); meta holds status, reason, periode (c(debut, fin) actually used), n_annees, bornes (tmax, precip, mode, reference, reason), palette (name, classes, colors, ncol = n, zero = list(tmax, precip) — the [0, 1] position of the zero change on each axis, for the dashed 0/0 lines), unites, source, resolution_native, crs, attribution and fichiers.

Lifecycle

Experimental: may change in any release, without deprecation (spec 057).

See also

climat_ete_series(), climat_nuages_annuels()
